leads.claim: The flight crew searched for debris related to UAP sightings but identified the objects as conventional rocket and projectile remnants.
leads.why: The document explicitly identifies the debris as conventional remnants from rockets and projectiles, making it prosaic.
leads.quote: Each time, we determined it was remnants from rockets and other projectiles

doc_verdict: The document contains no evidence of UAP-related material, as all debris identified was explicitly attributed to conventional rockets and projectiles.
